title: ONGC KGD 98/2 and Ichthys: as-built drawings and 3D models
anonTitle: As-built drawings and 3D models for two offshore developments
challenge: At close-out, the EPC contractor had to hand the operators as-built drawings and 3D models that matched the installed facilities.
